description:
Outcome of a 4-round adversarial architecture review of the UAT layer. The
spec budgeted ~1,500 LOC across 13 modules (_project/specs/uat-framework.md:132).
Actual UAT is ~6,476 production LOC (~4.3x) + ~5,730 test LOC + 1,729 YAML
across 20+ modules + 31 configs.

Both sides agree the production concern is valid (the rebuttal's "test LOC !=
production complexity" is fair, but prod alone is still 4.3x). Even after
excluding explorer-prep (356 LOC) and legitimate evidence artifacts (746 LOC),
~5,300 prod LOC remains in the plumbing/core/preflight/docker machinery the
ORIGINAL 1,500-LOC spec was meant to cover. Release-gate orchestration
explains the audit trail; it does not explain a 3.6x remaining core.

This item is the deliberate reconciliation: do not leave a 4x gap between
charter and reality unexplained. It depends on the charter decision in
[[uat-certification-wording-charter-decision]] because the chartered scope
determines what the budget should be. The decision work produces one
reconciliation path; the unchosen path is recorded as deferred rather than as
a pending work unit that blocks TODO completion.

work_units.notes:
Re-measure the prod LOC figure with a per-module breakdown. Bucket:
core-exercise (execute, matrix, runner, enumerate, ladder, cleanup),
evidence-artifacts (report rollups, packaging, resume, source-SHA),
explorer-prep, docker lifecycle (721 LOC, default-OFF), plumbing
(orchestrator/config/cli ~1,783 LOC). Record a compact summary.
MEASURED 2026-06-01 (on merged develop, prod = tests/uat/*.py minus test_*/conftest):
  prod ~6,476 across 21 modules; test ~5,730; yaml ~1,729.
  Buckets: plumbing (orchestrator 649/config 578/_cli 556)=1,783;
  core-exercise (execute 751/matrix 384/runner 265/enumerate 137/cleanup 121/ladder 83)=1,741;
  preflight+compat+timeouts (preflight 407/preflight_budget 216/compatibility 198/timeouts 130)=951;
  docker lifecycle default-OFF (docker_assets 504/docker_cleanup 372)=876;
  evidence artifacts (validate 303/report 273/package 170)=746; explorer-prep 356; package init markers 23.
  ROOT CAUSE of the 4.3x: (a) the spec table OMITTED 4 modules entirely
  (_cli 556/docker_cleanup 372/preflight_budget 216/compatibility 198 = 1,342 LOC),
  and (b) phases/plumbing were under-estimated. No discretionary bloat in load-bearing buckets.
  NOTE: docker_assets 504 includes ~140 LOC added by uat-single-connection-registry (this batch).
work_units.summary: Re-measure prod/test/YAML LOC per module and bucket each (core / evidence-artifacts / explorer-prep / plumbing)

work_units.notes:
Gated by [[uat-certification-wording-charter-decision]] — chartered scope
sets the target budget. Candidate cut areas (path A): orchestrator/config/cli
plumbing (1,783 LOC) and the default-OFF docker lifecycle (721 LOC, where
docker_manage_platforms defaults false).
DECIDED 2026-05-31 (user): Path B — revise the budget with per-bucket
rationale. Evidence (w0) shows the gap is undercounting of chartered
surface (4 unlisted modules + under-estimated phases), not bloat; a forced
cut would damage load-bearing capability. Charter dep satisfied: #4 (Path A,
"release-gate orchestration") merged in PR #729. Path A recorded as deferred.
